Drug Deaths Rise in Scotland Amid Opioid Concerns

Drug-related deaths in Scotland saw an 11% increase last year, according to new data. This rise is partly attributed to the presence of nitazenes, a new form of powerful synthetic opioid, in the illicit drug market. Concerns have been raised about the "toxic and unpredictable supply" of these substances.
